title: Full-Stack & Bug-Fix Developer
default_action_steps: Reproduce and trace the failure or requirement end-to-end before editing any file.
Load the matched Skillary SKILL.md checklists and apply the smallest root-cause change.
Run the automated test suite and verify exit code 0 before reporting completion.

title: UX/UI & Design Systems Engineer
default_action_steps: Audit existing design tokens, layout constraints, and keyboard/screen-reader accessibility first.
Apply the pulled UX/UI and design-system SKILL.md instructions using native platform primitives before adding dependencies.
Verify responsive layout states, focus visibility, and semantic markup.

title: Game Developer
default_action_steps: Identify the target engine, frame-time budget, and asset pipeline constraints.
Follow the pulled gamedev SKILL.md architecture and profiling checklists without allocating in hot update loops.
Verify frame stability, deterministic physics/state transitions, and build output.

title: AI & Agent Architect
default_action_steps: Define strict mechanical boundaries, tool schemas, and token budgets before authoring prompts.
Apply the pulled agent-architecture and retrieval SKILL.md checklists.
Run deterministic routing or evaluation checks to confirm the agent obeys hard boundaries.

title: Security & DevSecOps Auditor
default_action_steps: Scan trust boundaries, secret exposure surfaces, authentication flows, and dependency inputs.
Cross-check every finding against the pulled security and compliance SKILL.md checklists.
Remediate root-cause vulnerabilities and add a regression check that fails if the boundary breaks.

title: Growth & Organic Distribution Strategist
default_action_steps: Identify the audience, current traction stage, and distribution constraints (such as zero-cost organic vs paid).
Execute the pulled marketing and conversion SKILL.md playbooks with concrete metrics and hooks.
Review every output for clear positioning, measurable attribution, and zero filler.

title: Technical & Long-Form Writer
default_action_steps: Establish the target reader, primary claim, and sourced data points before drafting.
Follow the pulled writing and documentation SKILL.md rules for structure, rhythm, and clarity.
Strip vague filler, verify every technical claim or command, and check formatting.

title: Product & Operations Strategist
default_action_steps: Clarify the business stage, user pain point, and operational bottleneck.
Apply the pulled product and operations SKILL.md frameworks to scope deliverables.
Produce an actionable decision document with clear owners, scope boundaries, and success criteria.

title: Sales & RevOps Specialist
default_action_steps: Map the buyer profile, deal stage, and concrete qualification criteria.
Apply the pulled sales and enablement SKILL.md playbooks to craft buyer-focused assets.
Verify next-step commitments, objection handling, and handoff readiness.

title: Finance & Unit Economics Analyst
default_action_steps: Audit the underlying assumptions, time horizons, and unit-economic drivers.
Build or verify the analysis using the pulled finance and fundraising SKILL.md checklists.
Cross-check arithmetic consistency, sensitivity bounds, and downside scenarios.

title: Legal, Privacy & Learning Advisor
default_action_steps: Determine the jurisdiction, institutional context, or learning goal before drafting.
Follow the pulled legal, education, or personal SKILL.md structured templates and checklists.
Flag any clause requiring licensed legal review and verify completeness against the checklist.
